categories.main_business_segments: Nantong Xingqiu Graphite Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, sales, and maintenance services of graphite materials, graphite products, graphite equipment, and complete systems. Key products include special chemical graphite materials, graphite synthesis furnaces, graphite heat exchangers, graphite reaction towers, and related accessories, serving various chemical and industrial sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as chlorine-hydrogen combustion for hydrochloric acid synthesis, integrated heat recovery, and impregnation techniques to enhance graphite material properties. It has developed proprietary technologies including high-efficiency mixing, automatic ignition systems, and high-purity graphite production methods. Manufacturing involves complex processes like molding, baking, graphitization, and multiple impregnation cycles to improve corrosion resistance and mechanical strength.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are large state-owned enterprises and listed companies in downstream industries such as chlor-alkali, polysilicon, organic silicon, epoxy chloropropane, phosphorus chemical, pesticides, pharmaceuticals, fine chemicals, new materials, environmental protection, fluorine chemical, zirconium, chemical fiber, and rare earth sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are mainly based in China with headquarters in Jiangsu Province. The company is actively expanding its international presence, focusing on overseas markets including India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa, particularly within the Belt and Road Initiative regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nantong Xingqiu Graphite operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the graphite supply chain, manufacturing graphite materials and equipment for industrial applications. It also extends upstream by producing graphite raw materials through its wholly-owned subsidiary Inner Mongolia Xingqiu New Materials Technology Co., Ltd.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in energy-saving, environmental protection, and high-efficiency graphite equipment. R&D priorities include developing high-purity hydrochloric acid production, advanced heat recovery systems, improved impregnation agents, and high-performance graphite materials. It invests significantly in R&D centers and collaborates with academic institutions to foster technological advancements and industry-leading products.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of graphite materials, equipment, and system solutions to industrial customers. The company also earns income from maintenance services and after-sales support. Pricing strategies are cost-plus and differentiated based on product type, customer credit, and contract terms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in China's graphite chemical equipment industry, particularly in the chlor-alkali sector where its graphite synthesis furnace has the highest market share domestically. It competes with international firms from Japan, Germany, and France, which dominate high-end graphite materials globally. Nantong Xingqiu is recognized as a national champion and a specialized, innovative 'little giant' enterprise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 632.6 million, a 17.92% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to weak downstream demand. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 148 million, showing slight growth. Total assets reached RMB 2.94 billion with a stable asset-liability ratio around 45%. The company maintains positive cash flow and continues investing in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nantong Xingqiu Graphite differentiates itself through integrated offerings of materials, equipment, systems, and services, emphasizing energy efficiency, environmental sustainability, and high product quality. Its proprietary technologies enable superior corrosion resistance, heat transfer efficiency, and durability in harsh chemical environments. The company’s strong after-sales service network and customization capabilities enhance customer loyalty and market competitiveness.
